# Legacy Office fixtures

Genuine OLE compound files (Word 97-2003 `.doc`, Excel 97-2003 `.xls`) from the
[Apache POI test data](https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data), licensed under the
Apache License 2.0. They are kept as binaries so the tests exercise the real BIFF and Word binary
formats rather than renamed OOXML packages.
